description: Land Acquisition - Galwaladeniya, Homagama D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains a ministerial order directing the acquisition officer to take possession of a specific land parcel, including detailed descriptions of the land's location, boundaries, and extent. The content focuses exclusively on land matters (acquisition and property description) without combining government personnel details with portfolio responsibilities, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4) rather than a government-related classification.
